correctness.rationale: Substitution of p=v=0 into the printed ODE gives A'= -q(t)A with q(t)>=mu, hence A(t)<=A(0)e^{-mu t}. This contradicts any positive asymptotic distance from the full boundary. The invariant-face endemic equilibrium is obtained algebraically and all four residuals vanish; verify.py checks an exact rational witness.

originality.rationale: The accepted statement is an explicit counterexample to the source’s stronger all-state persistence theorem on an endpoint included in its stated parameter range. The source’s own boundary proof fails exactly at that endpoint, and targeted semantic and exact-phrase searches did not locate a prior correction or a stronger statement that already supplies this counterexample.
residual_risks: A correction not indexed by the searched sources could exist, although the inspected publisher page reports only a funding-section revision.
The finding does not settle the separate disease-only persistence statement on a reduced boundary state space.
